name: Walls Of Jericho
overview: The Walls of Jericho represent a pivotal moment in Israel's conquest of Canaan, demonstrating God's power to deliver His people through miraculous intervention. Despite the city's strong fortifications and being tightly shut against Israel (Joshua 6:1), God commanded a unique strategy of faith involving seven days of marching and a great shout that caused the walls to fall flat (Joshua 6:5, 6:15). The story also highlights God's grace in preserving Rahab and her household because of her faith and protection of the spies, underscoring God's mercy amid judgment (Joshua 2:1, 2:15; 6:17). This event underscores the Lord's sovereignty over human defenses and His faithfulness to those who trust Him.
